messages:
sanjay: heads-up — two customers noticed rerank score shifts after we moved to 1536-dim embeddings. they call it a "+/- swap" in results when queries hit the new model. asking for product decision: compatibility shim, dual-serving, or roll back.
maria: do we have a minimal repro and delta numbers?
sanjay: yes. quick repro: query A used to rank doc1>doc2, now doc2>doc1. cosine delta ~0.06 on average. i pasted a small log below.
eli: can you paste the vector diffs? might be normalization related (l2 vs. cos) or batch mean shift.
sanjay: log snippet:
```
old_embed = [0.12, -0.03, ...]  # 1024 dim
new_embed = [0.08, -0.01, ...]  # 1536 dim (padded + reproject)
cos(old,doc) = 0.743
cos(new,doc) = 0.692
```

tara: quick thoughts — three vectors of approaches:
  1) compatibility shim: on-serve project legacy clients to new space with a deterministic mapping. less ops churn but risk residual drift.
  2) dual-serving: continue serving legacy 1024 for pinned tenants, new 1536 for others. higher cost, clear SLA boundaries.
  3) migration tool + eval harness: run both in parallel, compute regression score, auto-rollback gates.

maria: acceptance criteria we need before rollout:
  - regressions < 0.5% on top-k reorder for flagged customer prompts
  - per-tenant opt-in flag and opt-out window 90 days
  - monitoring: per-query rerank change metric + alert at 0.2% regression
  - documented API contract for embedding dims and an error code if mismatch

eli: edge cases:
  - batched requests mixing old/new model versions => KV cache mismatch and token-level artifacts
  - normalization semantics: if clients L2-norm on their side, we need to guarantee same post-quantization behavior
  - embedding-length truncation for older index formats

sanjay: proposal: short term implement a runtime flag (compat-mode) that triggers a reproject shim and also runs new model in shadow to collect stats. medium term: dual-serving for enterprise tenants that require absolute stability. timeline: compat-mode in 2 sprints, dual-serving plan in 6.

tara: testing checklist:
  - unit test for repro mapping
  - integration smoke using customer QA prompts
  - canary 1% traffic with immediate rollback on regression > 0.5%
  - evaluation harness to run nightly full-corpus regression

ops-bot: deploy-plan locked: feature-branch -> staging -> canary -> prod. auto rollback hook set to "rerank-regression" threshold.

maria: one more ask from PMs — product-side acceptance gating: marketing & support need 2 weeks notice + migration playbook. include snippet for client SDK change.

sanjay: example client error we will return if dims mismatch:
```
HTTP 400
{
  "error": "embedding_dim_mismatch",
  "expected_dim": 1536,
  "message": "Client embeddings must be 1536; set compat_mode=true to use legacy mapping for 90 days"
}
```

eli: ok — i'll take the compat shim PR. sanjay can own canary metrics + eval harness. tara will write the migration playbook. maria will coordinate customer comms.

maria: thanks — i'll add these as launch gates in the PRD and sync with legal for SLA language. :+1
